tables.comment: 繰り返しの予定と、その規則

columns.comment: 最初の回の日付

columns.name: visit_info_id
columns.comment: 訪問のときだけ。予定ごとに 1 つ

columns.name: is_over_time_work
columns.extra_def: GENERATED ALWAYS AS (start_time >= '17:00:00'::time without time zone) STORED
columns.comment: 開始が 17 時以降。開始の時刻から生成する

columns.name: frequency
columns.comment: weekly、monthly

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.comment: 1（月曜）から 7

columns.name: day_of_month
columns.comment: 1 から 31

columns.name: week_of_month
columns.comment: 1 から 5

columns.name: end_date
columns.comment: この日を含む。NULL なら終わりなし

columns.name: version
columns.comment: 更新の番号。回を除外するたびに 1 つ増える

indexes.name: recurring_schedules_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recurring_schedules_pkey ON public.recurring_schedules USING btree (id)

indexes.def: CREATE INDEX recurring_schedules_staff_idx ON public.recurring_schedules USING btree (facility_id, staff_id)

constraints.name: recurring_schedules_rule_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((frequency = 'weekly'::text) AND (day_of_month IS NULL) AND (week_of_month IS NULL)) OR ((frequency = 'monthly'::text) AND (day_of_month IS NOT NULL) AND (day_of_week IS NULL) AND (week_of_month IS NULL)) OR ((frequency = 'monthly'::text) AND (day_of_month IS NULL) AND ((day_of_week IS NULL) = (week_of_month IS NULL)))))

constraints.name: recurring_schedules_staff_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (facility_id, staff_id) REFERENCES users(facility_id, id)

constraints.name: recurring_schedules_visit_info_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (facility_id, visit_info_id) REFERENCES visit_infos(facility_id, id)

tables.name: public.visit_info_details
tables.comment: 訪問の情報と名前を結合したビュー
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW visit_info_details AS (
 SELECT vi.id,
    vi.facility_id,
    vi.patient_id,
    pa.name AS patient_name,
    vi.assigned_staff_id,
    au.username AS assigned_staff_name,
    vi.companion_id,
    cu.username AS companion_name,
    vi.service_code_id,
    sc.code AS service_code
   FROM ((((visit_infos vi
     JOIN patients pa ON ((pa.id = vi.patient_id)))
     JOIN users au ON ((au.id = vi.assigned_staff_id)))
     LEFT JOIN users cu ON ((cu.id = vi.companion_id)))
     JOIN service_codes sc ON ((sc.id = vi.service_code_id)))
)

tables.name: public.schedule_details
tables.comment: 一覧の読み出しに使う、予定と訪問の情報と名前を結合したビュー
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW schedule_details AS (
 SELECT s.id,
    s.facility_id,
    s.schedule_type_id,
    st.code AS schedule_type_code,
    st.name AS schedule_type_name,
    s.date,
    s.start_time,
    s.end_time,
    s.is_over_time_work,
    s.staff_id,
    u.username AS staff_name,
    s.title,
    s.description,
    s.recurring_schedule_id,
    s.original_date,
    s.visit_info_id,
    vid.patient_id,
    vid.patient_name,
    vid.assigned_staff_id,
    vid.assigned_staff_name,
    vid.companion_id,
    vid.companion_name,
    vid.service_code_id,
    vid.service_code,
    c.id AS cancel_id,
    c.reason AS cancel_reason,
    s.created_at,
    s.updated_at,
    s.version
   FROM ((((schedules s
     JOIN schedule_types st ON ((st.id = s.schedule_type_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.id = s.staff_id)))
     LEFT JOIN visit_info_details vid ON ((vid.id = s.visit_info_id)))
     LEFT JOIN schedule_cancels c ON ((c.schedule_id = s.id)))
)

tables.name: public.recurring_schedule_details
tables.comment: 一覧の読み出しに使う、繰り返しの予定と訪問の情報と名前を結合したビュー
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW recurring_schedule_details AS (
 SELECT rs.id,
    rs.facility_id,
    rs.schedule_type_id,
    st.code AS schedule_type_code,
    st.name AS schedule_type_name,
    rs.date,
    rs.start_time,
    rs.end_time,
    rs.is_over_time_work,
    rs.staff_id,
    u.username AS staff_name,
    rs.title,
    rs.description,
    rs.frequency,
    rs.day_of_week,
    rs.day_of_month,
    rs.week_of_month,
    rs.end_date,
    rs.visit_info_id,
    vid.patient_id,
    vid.patient_name,
    vid.assigned_staff_id,
    vid.assigned_staff_name,
    vid.companion_id,
    vid.companion_name,
    vid.service_code_id,
    vid.service_code,
    rs.created_at,
    rs.updated_at,
    rs.version
   FROM (((recurring_schedules rs
     JOIN schedule_types st ON ((st.id = rs.schedule_type_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.id = rs.staff_id)))
     LEFT JOIN visit_info_details vid ON ((vid.id = rs.visit_info_id)))
)

tables.comment: 予定を外部のカレンダーに書き出す待ち。予定の変更と同じトランザクションで積む

columns.name: status
columns.comment: pending（書く）、succeeded（書いた）、conflict（外部で変わっていた）、failed（書けなかった）

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: 終わっていない行に積み直した回数に 1 を足した値。書いている間に積み直されたかを比べる

columns.name: attempts
columns.comment: 書こうとした回数。再送の間隔と上限に使う

columns.name: next_attempt_at
columns.comment: この時刻より後に書く

columns.name: locked_until
columns.comment: 書いている処理が持つ期限。過ぎたら、ほかの処理が書いてよい

columns.name: overwrite
columns.comment: 外部の予定の etag を比べずに、buddy の内容で書き直すか

columns.name: error_code
columns.comment: 最後に書けなかった理由。外部の予定の題名とカレンダーの ID を含めない。unappliable は、外部の変更を buddy の予定に読み替えられなかったこと
